newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges back on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges back on profit taking.

text.p: SIMEX Brent futures fell in late afternoon trading as profit taking cut into London's overnight five-year highs.
November last traded at $24.40 per barrel, down nine cents from the last IPE close, as 1,828 lots were crossed by a broker.

November had earlier traded two lots at $24.49, matching London's overnight settlement. November had traded at a fresh five-year high of $24.50 on Monday in London on the back of a strong NYMEX futures market.
A broker said he expected November Brent to trace back to $24.30 before finding support.
NYMEX crude for November traded a steady $25.24 per barrel through the Asian day after rising 51 cents in New York to close at $25.24.
